criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 3, 4 and 9 strong with exact counts; 7's board flat and its mount two plates, 8 type on a plate, 2 a flat plan, 5 a spreadsheet grid, 6 a grey-middle towel, 1's hood a bent plate.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One floodlit interior and two working motifs; the gold accent carries several meanings and the camera design varies frame to frame; 6 and 8 sit outside the deck's value.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and the drawn counts are exact; 8's quotes verbatim. Frame 7 prints the blog's untested turnover claim on the limit frame while the paper's own operative-minutes null (c12) appears on no slide; 5's headline reads a 95% interval as bounds; the first comment omits c12; 95 traces only to c6's quote.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and where clear; 9 gives patients a concrete stake; no deciding body or dated next step.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, 2 pays at once, 3 to 4 a real reveal; the close pivots to privacy.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, careful and attributed; clinical, little Texas specificity; one meta caption line.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: A new world; the one-object-per-unit move and the instrument repeat recent decks.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat board with a meaningless gold block; the camera between two disconnected plates.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: One screwed wall plate and a single arm; magnetic case strips with bevels and a pen tray; the gold block steel.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A pale grey plate carrying DOM type, lifting the frame into the mid tones.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Bleed the page off the bottom and right edges, rake the key low, steel to near black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat floor plan with stub cameras.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A three-quarter oblique view with walls three times taller; larger camera brackets.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Bays and lids seen square read as a spreadsheet grid.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A low oblique view so lids stand in perspective; the white tape a bright ridge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A mid-grey towel texture; clamps read as tweezers.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A pool on the gold clamp with the rest to black; curved jaws, box lock and ratchet teeth.

_note: Transcribed from the judge's hand-back by the showrunner; scores, total and weakest frames as returned, reasons abridged.
